snapshot.scope: Independent Product Planning review of source-bound exact authority: accepted SourceRecords alone define scope, ambient tools are absent before confirmation/effect, six locales use neutral exact-source intent, preserved handles hide original paths, and statuses remain unchanged.

reviewers.independence: Product Planning reviews existing security, Pi catalog, runtime policy, source storage, API, UI, decision and trace owners; Development owns implementation/reproduction and UI owns mechanical locale copy.

dimensions.summary: Accepted SourceRecords are the sole resource set; preserved handles hide raw original paths and optional future staging requires recovery-safe cleanup.
Security, Pi, runtime, API and UI agree that source-bound catalogs exclude ambient tools and confirmation cannot widen scope.
SEC/PI planned targets name exact-source exclusion and stale-call failure while every Requirement/Exit/Phase status stays unchanged.
Development can gate catalog registration before confirmation/effect; text-only authority, typed source tools and URL ingress remain isolated.
Existing owners and one decision carry the P0 rule with no new document, status, control, modal or budget increase.

verification.command: npm run verify:verify-scripts-integrity && npm run verify:contracts
verification.evidence: Submitted-turn and high-risk contracts distinguish exact-source catalogs from unchanged text-only authority without a new IPC or permission state.

verification.command: npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:decisions && npm run verify:documentation-leanness
verification.evidence: Owner links, amended decision and governed byte limits pass without a new document.
PIGE-SEC-003, PIGE-PI-003 and E8 gaps name the P0 boundary while all statuses remain unchanged.

coordination.compatibility: Text-only explicit tasks retain current high-risk confirmation; exact-source inspect/parse/OCR/retrieval/write and dedicated URL ingress remain available without ambient capability widening.
coordination.acknowledgement: Planning freezes catalog/resource and neutral fallback semantics only; implementation, six locale bytes, real Electron evidence, image OCR and status promotion remain outside this candidate.

nonBlockingRisks: Development must prove every source-bound ingress omits command/filesystem/package/generic-fetch adapters and rejects stale or invented excluded calls before confirmation, execution and persistence.
UI must mechanically replace the six locale values without adding a control/modal; always-staging remains optional defense-in-depth and cannot replace catalog exclusion.
